usage: The word 冰水 (bing1 seoi2) means iced water and is used as a noun referring to cold water with ice.
It is often requested in restaurants or cafes when you want a cold drink, especially in hot weather.
You can say '我要一杯冰水' to mean 'I want a glass of iced water.'
It can be used on its own or with measure words like '杯' (glass) or '樽' (bottle).
It’s commonly understood and polite to ask for '冰水' when you do not want sugary or flavored drinks.
